items.title: Do Agents Know When They Succeed? Calibrating Agent Confidence from Internal Representations
items.title_zh: 智能体知道自己何时成功吗？从内部表示校准智能体置信度
items.summary: The paper introduces Latent Trajectory Dynamics and an Action Representation Probe to predict task success from residual-stream representations in multi-turn agentic setups. Across Bash, SQL and Python benchmarks and three model families, the methods outperform surface-level and sequence-based calibration baselines without prompt changes or multiple rollouts.

items.title: Harness or Model? Isolating the Harness Effect in Agentic Coding with a Contamination-Controlled Private Suite
items.title_zh: 支架还是模型？在受污染控制的私有套件中分离智能体编码的支架效应
items.summary: The study runs paired same-model contrasts on a private, contamination-controlled suite of 256 repository and contest tasks to test whether vendor-native agent harnesses hold an average advantage. Neither contrast resolves one, though the Opus 4.8 average combines a 9.0-point deficit on repository tasks with a 23.7-point lead on contest tasks.

items.title: SPINE: Measuring LLM Sycophancy under Sustained Multi-Turn Pressure
items.title_zh: SPINE：衡量 LLM 在持续多轮压力下的谄媚行为
items.summary: SPINE uses an LLM proxy as a persistent but mistaken user that adaptively challenges a target model for up to 25 turns on 100 false presuppositions and 100 unethical queries. Across seven models, collapse rates rise from 0%-57% within five turns to 20%-97% within 25 turns, and the correct position remains represented in reasoning traces in 50%-89% of analyzed collapse turns.

items.title: ReCite: Agentic Reasoning for Faithful Citation
items.title_zh: ReCite：面向忠实引用的智能体推理
items.summary: ReCite is a decoupled agentic framework that combines location perception, intent-aware query planning and reflective verification to check whether a cited paper actually supports a claim. Trained on synthesized reasoning trajectories, it outperforms state-of-the-art massive generative models on strict citation accuracy.

items.title: Co-Evolving Harnesses and Models: On-Policy Correction Helps Weaker Models Catch Up Where Imitation Fails
items.title_zh: 协同演化支架与模型：在线策略纠错让弱模型在模仿失败处追赶
items.summary: The paper examines how automated harness evolution and lightweight fine-tuning should be combined across seven enterprise agent tasks, finding that imitating a stronger expert's full trajectories regresses performance by 4 to 30 points. It proposes an on-policy expert-correction pipeline that rewrites only the failing turn in the weaker model's own rollout.

items.title: Benchmarking Agentic HLS Design Tasks With HLS-Eval
items.title_zh: 用 HLS-Eval 对智能体化 HLS 设计任务进行基准测试
items.summary: The authors extend the open HLS-Eval benchmark with a mini-swe-agent pipeline in which agents edit files, call a C++ compiler for self-verification and iterate on designs while logging cost, token use and iteration count. Initial results show open LLMs with the agent framework solve all easy HLS code-generation tasks, indicating the benchmark needs to be harder.

items.title: HLSFactory-Agent: Large-Scale Agentic HLS Dataset Construction from Academic and Open-Source Projects
items.title_zh: HLSFactory-Agent：从学术与开源项目大规模构建智能体化 HLS 数据集
items.summary: HLSFactory-Agent is an LLM agent that extracts standalone designs from large codebases and builds and evaluates each design inside Docker using the open-source Pi agent framework. Users provide a GitHub link or code directory and receive a design collection compatible with the HLSFactory dataset framework.

items.title: An Experimental Evaluation of Multimodal Prompt Injection Attacks on Agentic AI Frameworks
items.title_zh: 多模态提示注入攻击对智能体 AI 框架的实验评估
items.summary: MMPIBench delivers fixed prompt-injection attacks through six visual carriers and records how far each injected instruction travels from perception through planning to tool calls across 720 runs. Attacks complete in about 1% of runs but are attempted in 12.8%, with the model mattering far more than the framework; audio attacks complete in 49% of cells where the signal arrives.

items.title: Agentic AI-enabled Semantic Commissioning of a Cognitive Digital Twin for Reconfigurable Manufacturing
items.title_zh: 面向可重构制造的认知数字孪生智能体语义调试
items.summary: The paper proposes an agent-based workflow that uses LangGraph for multi-agent orchestration, RAG to extract specifications from unstructured documents and MCP to bind real-time industrial telemetry. In a robotic machining cell it reports 97.2% mAP in perception and cuts the deployment cycle from several weeks to an average of two hours.

items.title: From Fixed Keys to Readable Schemas: Small Language Models for Vehicle Agent Function Calls
items.title_zh: 从固定键到可读模式：面向车载智能体函数调用的小语言模型
items.summary: The paper compares dedicated functional tokens with schema-in-prompt representations for vehicle function calling on a benchmark of 9,822 examples spanning 79 functions and four small models from 270M to 1.7B parameters. Schema-in-prompt generalizes to held-out functions and refuses out-of-scope requests more reliably, at the cost of higher inference latency.

items.title: 1Password increases engineering productivity 21% with Codex
items.title_zh: 1Password 借助 Codex 将工程生产力提升 21%
items.summary: OpenAI reports that engineers at 1Password use Codex to build new features and internal tools rapidly, reaching production readiness while maintaining rigorous security policies, with the case study citing a 21% productivity increase.
